refactor: one node per function — single MCU node, single estimator, optimised UAV nodes (#97)

* feat(jetowl): add micro-ROS bridge for JetOwl FC

Connect the JetOwl STM32N657 flight controller to the ROS 2 graph
over micro-ROS on UDP/Ethernet (FC 192.168.10.2 -> agent :8888).

- ros2_jetowl_bridge: agent launch (source build or docker), link
  watchdog (/jetowl/link_ok, /diagnostics), arm relay from
  flight/status to the /jetowl/arm service
- Topic contract: the FC publishes /imu/data for the ESKF and
  consumes /control/attitude_setpoint + /control/thrust of
  ros2_control_system directly, no relay on the command path
- Unit tests for the protocol logic, netplan example, compose
  services, CHANGELOG entries

* feat(jetowl): decode FC rotor speed-loop masks

Firmware ee346f5 closes a per-rotor speed loop on DShot RPM telemetry
and publishes rotor_closed_mask / rotor_stall_mask in /jetowl/status.
parse_fc_status now decodes both (bit i = rotor i) and exposes
FcStatus.rotors_closed() / rotors_stalled(). README loop table and
CHANGELOG updated.

* refactor(fusion)!: merge sensor fusion into ESKF

ros2_sensor_fusion was a second 15-state EKF (plus a 9-state Python
EKF and unused CUDA filter kernels) on the same IMU/GNSS topics as
ros2_control_system/uav_state_estimator, which already covers its
inputs and adds baro, heading, chi-square gating with the message
covariance, NIS consistency and divergence recovery. Its CMake also
could not configure (export without install EXPORT, CUDA required,
sm_72 instead of Orin sm_87).

- remove Source/ROS2_Sensor_Fusion
- hexacopter_sim.launch.py sensor_fusion:=true now starts
  uav_state_estimator on /imu/data, /gps/fix, /gps/vel_cov with the
  MCU attitude (base_link->ENU) as heading source
- update mcu_link docs, Gazebo READMEs, IDE modules, CODEOWNERS and
  .claude scope lists

BREAKING CHANGE: package ros2_sensor_fusion removed; use
uav_state_estimator (/odometry/filtered).

Remove the ground-vehicle code that was kept but never run: the
ros2_control_cuda_solver library (CUDA MPC + cuBLAS, EKF, custom-frame

* refactor(jetowl)!: merge all MCU nodes into one

One C++ node, ros2_jetowl_bridge/jetowl_bridge (also the rclcpp
component ros2_jetowl_bridge::JetOwlBridgeNode), replaces the three
Jetson-side MCU nodes, with one link per microcontroller:

- fc: JetOwl FC over micro-ROS (port of the Python jetowl_bridge:
  link watchdog, /jetowl/link_ok, arm relay, firmware status)
- vision: OpenMV RT1062 over TCP/USB (port of ros2_microcontroller
  openmv_communication: same topics, measurement model, back-off,
  diagnostics, CSV log, run-time vision.* parameters)
- sensor_link: CRC-32 framed UDP from the hexacopter MCU / Gazebo
  virtual MCU (ros2_mcu_link moved here with history; protocol lib
  exported as ros2_jetowl_bridge::mcu_link; mcu_link_dump tool)

All links share one /diagnostics array and one launch file
(fc/vision/sensor_link/sim arguments). Start-up parameters are
validated; at run time only vision.* may change, other changes are
refused instead of silently ignored.

ros2_mcu_emulator and ros2_hexacopter_gazebo now use the merged
package. Tests: 8 gtest suites (5 moved, fc_protocol ported from
pytest, vision_link, node-level over rclcpp) + emulator suites pass.

BREAKING CHANGE: packages ros2_microcontroller and ros2_mcu_link are
removed; parameters are grouped by link (fc.*, vision.*,
sensor_link.*); headers move to ros2_jetowl_bridge/mcu_link/.
